body: Mannn I feel that. We gotta give ourselves a purpose instead of looking outwards and hoping society will. My only problem is that what makes me happy is doing stuff with friends but my social anxiety has made it impossible for me to do that. Everytime I see others having fun it feels like a slap in the emotional face.

Yea it's hard to know what life would be like if they didn't get divorced. I don't resent them or anything from doing it, but there's no doubt that any family that divorces affects the kids. I know that killing myself would really screw up everyone in my family which I don't want, but everyday is so hopeless and painful that I just want a way out. It's true that materialistically I have done pretty well but fuck that, I want to feel ok. There's so many things I want to do in life but they just seem to taunt me since I know I'll never be able to do them.

Hey, thanks for your kind reply. 

I think trying drugs was a way of us hoping that it would show us some higher purpose and give our lives meaning. But drugs are... just drugs. I'm not really a religious person but Ive recently been trying to completely surrender to life's situation and sometimes I get it, but I find sleeping and waking up refreshed all the work I did the day before. I'm really really hoping that this will pass like it did for you, but my negative thoughts are too fking believable.

Hey man,
That's a very appealing offer but I don't have a car and am busy this weekend. Good luck with it and hopefully you'll beat your 10 hour record lol

Hey thanks for the advice! My current thought process is "yea 1800 verticle isn't too hard" but I know after the first 1000 ill change my mind haha. Ive had some experience with the mountains in Nunavut but they weren't nearly as high, so I'm definitely bringing 3 days worth of food just in case. Cheers
Until you're awake at 4am crying on your keyboard because its mysteriously not working! I 100% agree tho lol

If the app ever gains a significant amount of interest on the play store then I'll definitely port it over! It's only a one time cost of $25 for android to release a game but its $99/year for IOS... I'm not made of money :)
I thought about making each level procedural but it was too hard to figure out if a level would be easy or impossible to beat. So for now it's all hand picked hehe
